fullDescription: WinTalent is a professional HR and recruitment SaaS dashboard style characterized by high-density information layout, clean typography using Plus Jakarta Sans, and a sophisticated 'Tech Blue' color palette (#2563eb). It features a structured multi-column layout with a 2-column history grid, a comprehensive analytical sidebar, and refined card components. Ideal for enterprise recruitment platforms, fintech back-offices, and data-intensive CRM systems requiring deep tracking and reporting capabilities.

structured.summary: A high-fidelity interview record dashboard with a tripartite layout: navigation sidebar, main filtered data grid, and an analytical statistics panel. The design uses a clean Slate-50 background, rounded-2xl cards with subtle shadows, and a consistent information hierarchy driven by bold, uppercase metadata labels.

style.description: Modern corporate tech aesthetic combining high-legibility sans-serif fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans) with monospaced data highlights (JetBrains Mono). Color palette focuses on Tech Blue (#2563eb) for primary actions and Slate-500/600 for secondary text. Features include 16px border-radius containers, light 1px borders (#e2e8f0), and subtle card-shadows (0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)).
style.prompt: Create a design system using the following specs: Background: #f8fafc (Slate-50). Primary Color: #2563eb (Blue-600). Accent: #1e3a8a. Borders: 1px solid #e2e8f0. Typography: Headers in 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 700 weight, tracking-tight; Body in 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 400-500 weight; Metadata in 10px font-size, uppercase, font-bold, tracking-widest. Spacing: Standard card padding is 24px (p-6). Component Radius: Main cards 16px (rounded-2xl), internal containers 12px (rounded-xl), buttons 8px (rounded-lg). Shadows: Box shadow 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05). Hover states: border color transitions to #93c5fd (blue-300) with a 200ms ease.

layout_and_structure.description: Three-pane structure: Left sidebar (navigation), Center main (search, record grid, pagination), and Right sidebar (KPIs and metrics).

prompts.prompt: Width: 288px (w-72). Features a top-aligned logo with a sub-label in 10px uppercase tracking-widest text. Nav items should be vertical stacks with 14px (text-sm) font size, 40px height, and include icons. Active state uses bg-blue-50 and text-blue-600. Bottom section includes a user profile card with a 32px circular avatar.

Height: 64px (h-16). Sticky position with a bottom border #e2e8f0. Left side contains the page title (text-lg font-bold) and a record counter separated by a vertical divider. Right side contains two buttons: an 'Export' button with border and a 'Primary Action' button in blue-600 with a shadow-blue-200.

Horizontal layout with gap-4. Search input is flex-1 with a left-aligned search icon. Filter dropdowns have a min-width of 140px and 40px height (py-2.5). Backgrounds for inputs should be bg-slate-50 or white depending on focus state.

Two-column grid for large screens. Individual cards use rounded-2xl with 1px border. Structure: Top row (Avatar 48x48px, Name text-base font-bold, Job title text-xs, Status badge in top right). Middle section: Grid-2-cols containing Interviewer name and Star Rating (e.g., 4.8 / 5.0). Bottom section: Remark area with bg-slate-50, rounded-lg, and 2-line text clamp for the italicized notes.

Width: 320px (w-80). Top features an 'Efficiency Dashboard' with a large primary blue card (#2563eb) showing a large KPI (text-3xl font-extrabold) and a progress bar. Below, a 2-column grid of mini-stat cards (bg-slate-50). Bottom section includes vertical progress bars for categorized distribution (e.g., Interviewer workloads) and a callout box in blue-50 with a 'Bulb' icon for optimization tips.

special_ui_components.description: High-impact visual metric card used in the sidebar.
special_ui_components.prompt: Design a card with bg-blue-600 and shadow-xl shadow-blue-100. Text color is white. Include a top label in blue-100 (text-xs), a main value in text-3xl font-extrabold, a horizontal progress bar (bg-blue-400/30 with white fill), and a bottom comparison trend line (e.g., '8% decrease') using uppercase metadata style.

special_ui_components.description: Data-rich record card with distinct sections.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a card with padding-6 and border-slate-200. The layout should be vertically stacked: Header (Avatar, Name, Title, Badge), Metadata Grid (bg-slate-50, items: Interviewer, Score), and Remark box (bg-slate-50, border-slate-100). On hover, the border must shift to blue-300 and the name text to blue-600.

structured.special_notes: MUST maintain the 10px uppercase tracking-widest labels for all section headers and metadata. MUST use line-clamp-2 on all candidate remarks. DO NOT use generic rounded corners; strictly follow the 16px radius for top-level cards and 8px/12px for nested elements. Ensure status badges (Pass, Pending, Fail) use light background variants of Green, Amber, and Red respectively.
